remarks:
Welcome to your private country retreat, where luxury living meets wide open space on 10 breathtaking acres in Ellery. This stunning contemporary home offers over 3000 square feet of living space with 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, perfectly designed for comfort, entertaining, and enjoying the outdoors.

From the moment you arrive, you will be captivated by the setting. Surrounded by trees and set far off the road, this property delivers unmatched privacy along with breathtaking views of the valley from the expansive deck and balcony off the primary suite.

Inside, the home features a warm and inviting design with natural wood finishes, a spacious kitchen with granite countertops, large island, and walk in pantry, plus a bright breakfast nook overlooking the landscape. The main living areas flow beautifully from the cozy living room with custom wood burning fireplace, formal dining space, sunroom, and a dedicated office that could easily serve as a den or whatever you like.

The second level offers generously sized bedrooms including a primary suite with a private balcony and spa like bath. A convenient second floor laundry room adds everyday ease. The finished walkout basement expands your living space with a full apartment including a kitchen/ bar area, living/recreation space, additional bedroom, and full bath, ideal for guests or entertaining.

Car enthusiasts, hobbyists, and outdoor lovers will appreciate the incredible garage space. The attached 3 car garage is heated with a pellet stove and includes additional upper level storage. A second detached garage features radiant heat, water, a large overhead bay, and space for a boat or car lift, along with an air compressor setup and additional second floor space.

Winter lovers will love that the snowmobile trail that runs directly through the property, offering immediate access for winter recreation. (can be relocated if someone doesn't want the trail there) All of this is just a short drive to Chautauqua Lake and Lake Erie, giving you the best of all seasons living.
